icon/svc-air: a tall air purifier filling the whole canvas: a light-grey tall boxy body with a blue top vent grille (three thick horizontal slats) and a small blue indicator button, narrow dark base. Bold chunky silhouette, taller than wide.
icon/svc-phone: a smartphone seen from the front filling the whole canvas: a tall rounded-rectangle body with thick dark-steel bezel and a plain light-blue blank screen with one thick white diagonal highlight band, a small dot camera at top. No icons or text on the screen. Bold chunky silhouette.
icon/svc-clean: a cleaning set filling the whole canvas: a wooden broom leaning diagonally with a thick gold bristle head at the bottom left, and two or three light-blue soap bubbles (hollow circles with a white highlight dot) floating at the top right. Bold chunky silhouette.
icon/svc-interior: a cozy sofa filling the whole canvas: a wide blue couch seen from the front, tall backrest, two thick armrests, two seat cushions with a lighter blue, short wooden legs. Bold chunky wide silhouette.
icon/svc-robot: a round robot vacuum cleaner filling the whole canvas, seen from slightly above: a thick light-grey disc with a darker navy ring edge, a blue round button on the top center, a small grey bumper arc at the front. Bold chunky round silhouette.
icon/svc-home: a house with a key filling the whole canvas: a small house with a red roof, cream walls, a blue door, and a big gold key in front at the bottom right. Bold chunky silhouette.
icon/coin: a single round gold coin seen from the front filling the whole canvas, thick outer rim in darker gold, inner face lighter gold with one plain bold star shape embossed in the middle. No letters, no numbers, no currency symbol.
icon/coin-pile: a small pile of gold coins filling the whole canvas: a stack of three coins at the back and two coins in front, all plain round gold with darker gold rims and one white highlight. No letters, no numbers, no symbols.
icon/fever: a single chunky flame filling the whole canvas: orange outer flame, red-orange base, a gold-yellow inner flame core, pointed tip curving slightly. Bold simple silhouette.
icon/crit: a bursting star filling the whole canvas: a bold gold eight-pointed burst star with a lighter yellow center and thick points of two different lengths. One shape only, no extra small sparkles.
icon/contract: a rolled scroll of paper filling the whole canvas: a cream parchment scroll with curled ends at top and bottom, and one round red stamp seal in the middle of it. No text lines, no letters.
icon/bundle: two thick interlocking chain rings filling the whole canvas: one blue ring and one gold ring overlapping and linked together diagonally, thick ring walls with clear holes. Bold silhouette.
icon/perk: a gold trophy cup filling the whole canvas: a wide gold cup with two thick handles on the sides, a short stem and a wide dark-gold base, one white highlight. No text.
icon/box-closed: a closed gift box filling the whole canvas: a blue gift box with a lighter blue lid, a thick gold vertical ribbon and a gold bow on top. No text.
icon/box-open: an open gift box filling the whole canvas: a blue gift box with its lid tilted open at the back, a gold ribbon on the front, and a bright gold glow-colored interior visible as a flat light-yellow shape inside the opening (no glow effect). No text.
icon/parcel: a cardboard parcel box with two small white feathered wings on its left and right sides, filling the whole canvas: sand-colored cardboard box with a cream tape stripe on the front, wings pointing up and out. Bold silhouette.
